promptVerbatim:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: game-ready PBR foliage albedo/opacity atlas for alpha-card meshes in a realistic 3D map
Primary request: create one square transparent PNG atlas containing twelve distinct, isolated Scots pine branch sprays and needle clusters
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background with clean alpha; no floor, sky, studio backdrop, frame, or cast shadow
Subject: natural Scots pine twig tips and branch sprays with individually readable fine needles, a few small brown twig bases, varied branching density and silhouette, cold-temperate late-summer condition
Style/medium: high-resolution botanical scan / photogrammetry-like product capture, physically plausible, highly detailed, not painted, not stylized, not low-poly
Composition/framing: strict 4-by-3 atlas grid; one complete foliage cutout per cell; generous equal padding; no overlap; varied rotations and scale while every spray stays entirely inside its cell
Lighting/mood: soft flat overcast diffuse light, consistent direction and exposure, minimal baked shading
Color palette: restrained dark pine green, muted olive variation, occasional subtle dry brown needle tips; avoid neon or saturated lime
Materials/textures: crisp needle silhouettes, natural roughness cues, fine twig bark, no chunky foliage blobs
Constraints: true transparent alpha, sharp antialiased edges, no opaque matte or color fringe, no text, labels, numbers, watermark, logos, duplicate sprays, full trees, trunks, cones, ground, sky, borders, or grid lines
Avoid: illustration, cartoon, bonsai, Christmas-tree iconography, artificial plastic needles, blurry halos, dense black shadows
useConstraints: Use only as an original TarkovZero Scots-pine foliage source for alpha-card proof assets.
Do not represent this atlas, its pixels, or derived geometry as an EFT or source-game texture.
Preserve this hashed source file; derive resized, edge-dilated, or channel-packed runtime textures in generated outputs.
Keep generated proof assets offline until visual, structural, deterministic, and runtime admission gates pass.
No claim of botanical, source-mesh, or in-game 1:1 equivalence is authorized by this provenance record.
